problems.note: Codebook Section 5 defines ai_vs_active to include web search and ai_vs_bau as AI assistance versus no assistance. The AI-forbidden control was expressly permitted Google, Wikipedia, the college library website, and other online information resources. Section 2.1 also says its computers had Google, Wikipedia, and the library website already open. Code this contrast as ai_vs_active. The extraction's explanation that both arms could use these resources does not remove the active aid from the control condition.

summary: Read an in-memory markdown conversion of the specified September 2026 PDF in consecutive chunks through all 103 pages, including Appendices A-D; the existing retrieval markdown is the older July version. Checked every estimate source against direct PyMuPDF page text and Table 5 against table extraction. Both control means, ITT and TOT coefficients, standard errors, outcome-specific control and total counts, delay, and study/arm counts are supported. Unprinted treatment counts, treatment means, SDs, p-values, test statistics, and confidence limits correctly remain null. Question, construct, measure, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person coding, and reported SE basis are supported. No in-scope outcome or contrast is missing under extraction rules 4-6. The two findings concern comparison_type: the control allowed web search and online resources, requiring ai_vs_active under codebook Section 5.
